NBC News. LD datePublished Wed 14 Oct 13:51 BST; LD dateModified Wed 14 Oct 20:55 BST; meta article:modified_time Thu 15 Oct 01:10 BST (THREE DIFFERENT STAMPS - report the spread). On-page dateline: Oct 14 2026 8:51 AM EDT / Updated Oct 14 2026 3:55 PM EDT.
Headline: 'Ukraine says new Starlink restrictions disrupt military as it reels from intel gaps and Trump clash'. By Abigail Williams, Dan De Luce, Gabe Gutierrez, Yuliya Talmazan and Jane Lytvynenko.
INDEPENDENT CORROBORATION OF THE INTEL GAP, NOT JUST ZELENSKY: 'Ukrainian officials and their European partners were already scrambling to understand the status of U.S. intelligence-sharing after the lack of alert ahead of two Russian ballistic missile strikes on Kyiv this week, two Ukrainian and two European officials told NBC News.' Two European officials said they were still trying to understand why there was no notice.
BUT THE ACCOUNTS CONFLICT: after the first attack Monday, two Ukrainian officials told NBC it was the result of 'a technical issue, or glitch' in US intelligence-sharing. One Ukrainian official on the second: 'We didn't receive warning for a second time, and this doesn't look like a coincidence.' A second Ukrainian official attributed it to bad weather. Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha, at the Warsaw Security Forum, reassured the audience that US intelligence-sharing continued, blaming the delayed alert on a 'special type of the weaponry' used by Russia.
Col. Yurii Ihnat, Ukrainian air force spokesman, Wednesday: after the second ballistic strike on Kyiv without warning, 'in the next three waves of attacks, notifications from partners about the use of ballistic weapons did come through.'
Trump, to reporters Tuesday: 'We are helping them, and we are sharing intel.' Trump denied withholding information critical to Ukraine's defence.
A spokesperson for Zelensky told NBC News the Starlink limitations remained in place late Wednesday.
Denys Sienik, Ukraine's charge d'affaires to the US: 'The technology helps us save the lives of civilians and prevent more destruction in Ukraine caused by the Russian side.'
7th Rapid Reaction Corps of the Ukrainian air assault forces: began 'noticing Starlink connectivity problems caused by data transfer speed limits' overnight; 'The drones kept flying, but the interruptions made them harder to control.' An army unit in the southeastern Zaporizhzhia region said Wednesday it had been forced to cancel some planned operations.
Beskrestnov said restrictions applied above 100 mph.
KEY SEQUENCING FACT: 'Kyiv said it had refrained from striking Russian energy targets to respect Trump's wishes' - so any resumption would be a reversal. Trump 'demanded that Ukraine stop attacking Russian oil refineries and called for Zelenskyy to be replaced'. Trump announced an 'energy ceasefire' that neither warring side appears to have agreed to.
The White House, SpaceX and Starlink did not immediately respond to requests for comment. Ukraine has reached out to the US government and SpaceX and had not received a response; Ukraine's armed forces learned of the limits from customer support after filing a complaint.
Monday attack: five ballistic missiles struck civilian infrastructure without notice.
Zelensky on 'Piers Morgan Uncensored': 'It's a little bit more complicated than just my emotions or my feelings' / 'I mean, our country has to survive.'
